interpretation: 全量原始数据组内等概率、两组等量抽样，比较P(X|T=1)与P(X|T=0)。不显著不证明联合分布相同或随机化；显著不单独证明随机化失败。置换依赖可交换性，未知分块、多实验和实体依赖未验证。这是事后描述性诊断，不用于正式模型选择。
sampling: independent uniform-priority reservoir without replacement within each arm
sampling_target: P(X|T=1) versus P(X|T=0); balanced arms, not population T prevalence
ks_method: two-sided asymptotic; unadjusted exploratory p-values; ties and dependence limit calibration
